greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga, kan ah Boqorka boqorrada, ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu waa adhijirkayga; waxba uma baahni.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo daawanaya meel ay ku kulmaan laba waddo oo waaweyn, halkaas oo dadku ay u socdaan jihooyin kala duwan, mid walba uu wato xamuulkiisa, werwerkiisa, iyo riyooyinkiisa. Waxaa jira dad si degdeg ah u socda, dad daalan, iyo dad u muuqda inay wadada ka luntay. Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee nebi Yexesqeel wuxuu inoo sawirayaa Ilaah oo ah Adhijirka dhabta ah. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Aniga qudhaydu ayaan raadin doonaa idahayga, waanan soo celin doonaa.' Bal qiyaas gacantaas oo si tartiib ah u soo ururinaysa idaha kala firdhay, iyadoo si jilicsan u xidhaysa wixii dhaawacmay. Tani waa ballanqaadka Boqorkeena Masiixa ah: inaanu marnaba keligeen naga tagin, xitaa marka ay daruuruhu madoobaadaan.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu lahaa qalbi u furnaa sidii adhijirka oo kale. Waxaan xusuustaa sheekada uu aabbihiis ka sheegay, markii uu Ben, isagoo aad u yar, uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu doonayo inuu dhiibo dhammaan lacagtii uu keydsaday si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayay. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ben wuxuu lahaa maskax aad u dhalaalaya oo ku saabsan tiknoolajiyadda, laakiin qalbigiisu wuxuu had iyo jeer ku jiray adeegga iyo jacaylka dadka kale. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan ka baqin inuu bixiyo waxa uu haysto, xitaa haddii ay ahaan lahayd inuu bixiyo 'con chim airlines' oo uu ku riyoon jiray, wuxuu had iyo jeer ku dhex jiray jacaylka qoyskiisa.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Boqorka uu fadhiisan doono carshigiisa, wuxuuna kala saari doonaa idaha iyo riyaha. Maxay ku kala duwan yihiin? 'Waayo, waan gaajaysnaa, idinkuna cunto ayaad i siisay.' Boqorkeena waa Boqor siiya naxariis. Ben, intii uu noolaa, wuxuu inoo tusay naxariistaas. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu dadka kale ka farxiyo, ha ahaato inuu la ciyaaro walaalkiis Ryan, ama inuu si xushmad leh ula hadlo dadka waaweyn. Wuxuu ahaa wiil 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka. Marka aan maanta ka fekerayno Boqorka, aynu xusuusanno inuu yahay kan inoo diyaariyey meel aan dhib lahayn, meel aan ilmo lahayn.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda u hurayaa adiga. Waligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo wajigiisa ha idin iftiimiyo. Nabad ku taga.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyey, inuu Rabbigu u naxariisto oo uu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah siiyo xoog, rajo, iyo nabad qalbigooda.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sidaasuu Rabbiga Ilaah leeyahay: Aniga qudhaydu ayaan raadin doonaa idahayga, waanan soo celin doonaa. Sida adhijirku u raadiyo idahiisa markuu dhex joogo idaha kala firdhay, ayaan aniguna u raadin doonaa idahayga. Waxaan ka soo bixin doonaa meel kasta oo ay ku kala firdheen maalintii daruuraha iyo gudcurka. Aniga qudhaydu ayaan adhijir u noqon doonaa idahayga, aniga qudhaydu ayaan nasin doonaa, ayuu leeyahay Rabbiga Ilaah. Kuwa lunsan ayaan raadin doonaa, kuwa baadiyaysanna waan soo celin doonaa, kuwa dhaawacanna waan xidhi doonaa, kuwa bukaanna waan bogsiin doonaa. Laakiin kuwa cayilan iyo kuwa xoogga leh ayaan baabbi'in doonaa, oo waxaan u adhijirayn doonaa si qumman. Adinkana, idahaygiiyow, Rabbiga Ilaah baa leh, waxaan kala xukumi doonaa idin iyo idin, iyo wananka iyo riyaha.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu waa adhijirkayga; waxba uma baahni. Daaqadaha cagaaran ayuu igu nasinayaa. Wuxuu i hor kaxeeyaa biyo deggan; naftayduu soo celiyaa. Wuxuu i mariyaa waddooyin qumman magaciisa aawadiis. Miis ayaad ii gogashay hortooda cadowgayga; madaxayga saliid ayaad ku subkaday; koobkaygu waa buuxdhaafay. Runtii wanaagga iyo naxariista ayaa i raaci doona cimrigayga oo dhan; waxaana ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga weligay.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow, Masiixu wuu ka sara kacay kuwii dhintay, isagoo ah midhkii ugu horreeyey ee kuwa hurday. Waayo, sida dhimashadu nin u timid, ayaa sarakicidda kuwii dhintayna nin u timid. Waayo, sida kuwii Aadan ku dhintay oo dhan, ayaa kuwa Masiix ku noolaan doona oo dhan, laakiin mid walba siday u kala horreeyaan: Masiixu waa midhkii ugu horreeyey; dabadeedna markuu yimaado, kuwa Masiix iska leh; dabadeedna waa dhammaadka, markuu boqortooyada u dhiibo Ilaaha Aabbihiis, markuu baabbi'iyo xukun kasta iyo amar kasta iyo awood kasta. Waayo, waa inuu boqortooyo ahaadaa ilaa uu cadowgiisa oo dhan cagtiisa hoos dhigo. Cadowga ugu dambeeya ee la baabbi'in doono waa dhimashada. Marka wax walba la hoos geliyo, markaas Wiilka qudhiisu wuxuu hoos iman doonaa kan wax walba u hoos geliyey, si Ilaah u noqdo wax walba wax walba.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi xertiisa: 'Markuu Wiilka Aadanuhu ku yimaado ammaantiisa, iyo malaa'igaha oo dhan la jira, wuxuu ku fadhiisan doonaa carshigiisa ammaanta leh, oo quruumaha oo dhan ayaa hortiisa la soo hor taagi doonaa. Wuxuuna kala saari doonaa midba midka kale, sida adhijirku u kala saaro idaha iyo riyaha. Idaha wuxuu dhigi doonaa midigtiisa, riyahana bidixdiisa. Markaas Boqorku wuxuu ku odhan doonaa kuwa midigtiisa jooga, 'Kaalaya, kuwa Aabbahay u barakeeyey, dhaxla boqortooyada loo diyaariyey idinka tan iyo aasaaskii dunida. Waayo, waan gaajaysnaa, idinkuna cunto ayaad i siisay, waan harraadsanaa, idinkuna cabbid ayaad i siisay, qariib baan ahaa, idinkuna waad i soo dhaweyseen, qaawan baan ahaa, idinkuna waad i dhayseen, bukaanna waan ahaa, idinkuna waad i booqateen.' Markaas kuwa xaqa ah ayaa u jawaabi doona oo odhan doona, 'Rabbiyow, goormaanu aragnay adigoo gaajaysan oo aanu ku quudinnay, ama harraadsan oo aanu ku cabbinnay? Goormaanu aragnay adigoo qariib ah oo aanu ku soo dhaweynay, ama qaawan oo aanu ku dhaynay? Goormaanu aragnay adigoo buka ama xabsiga ku jira oo aanu ku soo booqannay?' Boqorkuna wuxuu ugu jawaabi doonaa, 'Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, wax alla wixii aad u samayseen mid ka mid ah walaalahayga ugu yar, aniga ayaad ii samayseen.' Markaasuu ku odhan doonaa kuwa bidixdiisa jooga, 'Iga taga, idinkoo habaaran, oo gala dabka weligeed ah ee loo diyaariyey Ibliiska iyo malaa'igihiisa. Waayo, waan gaajaysnaa, idinkuna cunto iimaydaan siin, waan harraadsanaa, idinkuna cabbid iimaydaan siin, qariib baan ahaa, idinkuna iimaydaan soo dhaweyn, qaawan baan ahaa, idinkuna iimaydaan dhayin, bukaanna waan ahaa oo xabsigaan ku jiray, idinkuna iimaydaan booqan.' Markaasay iyaguna u jawaabi doonaan oo odhan doonaan, 'Rabbiyow, goormaanu aragnay adigoo gaajaysan ama harraadsan ama qariib ah ama qaawan ama buka ama xabsiga ku jira, oo aanan kuu adeegin?' Markaasuu ugu jawaabi doonaa, 'Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, wax alla wixii aydun u samayn weydeen mid ka mid ah kuwaas ugu yar, aniga ayaad ii samayn weydeen.' Kuwaasna waxay geli doonaan ciqaab weligeed ah, laakiin kuwa xaqa ah waxay geli doonaan nolol weligeed ah.'

day: The Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
